title: let TestRenderCLIViews render the projects set summary and run error texts from fixtures, so a UI pass can put them on the approval card

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
A role proposed this as tool feedback, and adj #513 was decided to file it:

Proposal: let TestRenderCLIViews render the projects set summary and run error texts from fixtures, so a UI pass can put them on the approval card
Role: ui
Run: ork-20261120-014727-adb2
Project: ork
Item: S307
Evidence: TestRenderCLIViews writes only status.txt, show.txt and help.txt; this slice changes only projects set and refusal texts

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestRenderCLIViewsWritesFiles` in `internal/cli/render_test.go`: with `-renders DIR` and no `-render-fixture`, the five default files; with `-render-fixture NAME[,NAME...]`, exactly NAME.txt for each name, each with non-empty text and no ANSI escapes; an unknown name fails; `-render-fixture` without `-renders` writes nothing. Red before the change: no flag, and no fixture of the eight names.
- One named test per new fixture in `internal/cli/render_test.go`, each asserting one literal line from its view: `TestRenderProjectsSetFixture`, `TestRenderProjectsSetRefusalsFixture`, `TestRenderWaveStartFixture`, `TestRenderStatusQueuedHeldFixture`, `TestRenderStatusEngineFixture`, `TestRenderSummaryRealFixture`, `TestRenderProjectsSetupFixture`, `TestRenderFakeReplyFixture`. Red before the change: no such fixture.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Owner decisions (2026-11-25): Which fixtures does S499 add, and under what names? -> confirm list: these named fixtures, each writing NAME.txt via `-render-fixture`, beside the five files `-renders` writes now. Names are `projects-set` (the `projects set` summary), `projects-set-refusals` (the refusal and run-error texts), `wave-start` (the no-terminal wave start output of S337), `status-queued-held` (status with queued and held runs), `status-engine` (engine runs, a multi-line wait, findings and a relay row), `summary-real` (real-length ids, titles and paths), `projects-setup` (the `projects setup` view of S249) and `fake-reply` (a command view whose daemon reply is faked, so a new subcommand renders without an overlay test). Each fixture gets one named test in `internal/cli/render_test.go` asserting one literal line from its view. The owner then picks that line..
